Build a PHW source caption

Source: R/labels.R
phw_caption.Rd

PHW reports put a bold, right-aligned line under each chart and table, such as "Source: Example system, 2024". Surveillance reports add "Data correct as of dd/mm/yyyy". Use the result in labs(caption = ...) or pass the same arguments to phw_finalise(), phw_flextable(), phw_reactable() or phw_plotly().

Usage

phw_caption(
  source = NULL,
  date = NULL,
  source_prefix = "Source: ",
  date_prefix = "Data correct as of ",
  date_format = "short",
  note = NULL,
  sep = "\n"
)

Arguments

source

Data source, e.g. "Example system, 2024". Can be NULL.

date

Optional extraction date. Adds "Data correct as of ...". A Date is formatted with date_format; a string is used as it is.

source_prefix, date_prefix

Text before the source and the date.

date_format

Passed to phw_date() as style.

note

Optional extra lines, e.g. a footnote or a team name.

sep

How the lines are joined. Use " | " for a single line.

Value

A string, or NULL if there is nothing to show.

Details

Every piece of wording can be changed, so the line can say anything your output needs, in any language.

Examples

phw_caption("Example system, 2024")
#> [1] "Source: Example system, 2024"
phw_caption("Sentinel GP network", date = as.Date("2026-11-03"))
#> [1] "Source: Sentinel GP network\nData correct as of 03/11/2026"
phw_caption("Example system", source_prefix = "Data: ", note = "Provisional figures")
#> [1] "Data: Example system\nProvisional figures"
